Discover the voice of your soul in this transformative workshop with internationally touring world music artist, teacher, and author Girish.

About this Event

A deep dive into transformational Breathwork, healing Mantra, and revitalizing Chi Gong with beloved yogi-musician & author, GIRISH. The PRANA RISING IMMERSION invites us to experience a radically expanded sense of our potential, our vitality, our wellness and wisdom through the transformational power of these ancient practices:
THE BREATH OF LIFE (9 HEALING BREATHS)
WIM HOF METHOD
PRIMAL CHI GONG
THE FIVE TIBETANS
MANTRA & CHANTING
The PRANA RISING IMMERSION workshop offers us the opportunity to experience a radically expanded sense of our potential, our vitality, our wellness and wisdom.
About the artist
Girish is an internationally touring world music artist, teacher, and author. He began his music career as a jazz drummer, spent five years as a monk in a Hindu monastery, returned to music as a session tabla player on more than a hundred world music albums, and for the past twelve years has written, recorded, and performed his own original music and taught Sanskrit mantras and chanting in music festivals and yoga studios all over the world. His seven albums have received critical acclaim from O, The Oprah Magazine, Yoga Journal, and The Guardian, among others. Girish's book, Music and Mantras, continues Girish's mission to share the art of meditation through music and mantra with the world.
This in-person-only event is sponsored by Hartford International University's Center for Transformative Spirituality.
